rating.verdict: A grindy zombie engine with sacrifice timing and graveyard recursion, which makes it an intermediate deck. It has no Game Changers or two-card combos, so it fits Bracket 2 (Core); a well-sequenced game can push into the top of that bracket.
strengths: Wilhelt replaces dying zombies and draws a card every end step
Seven zombie lords and anthems make even 2/2 tokens dangerous
Resilient to removal: Gravecrawler, Relentless Dead and Unbreathing Horde keep coming back
weaknesses: Graveyard hate (Bojuka Bog, Rest in Peace) blunts the recursion
Exile-based removal on Wilhelt slows the engine
Few answers to enchantments and artifacts

wins: Keep the horde churning: Wilhelt makes a 2/2 decayed zombie whenever another (non-decayed) zombie dies and lets you sacrifice one at end of turn to draw. Death triggers from Diregraf Captain and Vengeful Dead drain the table while lords pump the attackers.
plan: Cheap zombies (Cryptbreaker, Champion of the Perished, Undead Augur) and a mana rock. Bladestitched Skaab or Diregraf Captain on 3.
Cast Wilhelt. At your end step, sacrifice a decayed token (it can't block anyway) to draw a card.
Add lords (Death Baron, Lord of the Accursed, Cemetery Reaper) and engines like Endless Ranks of the Dead or Graveborn Muse. Trade creatures freely: each death makes a new zombie.
Swing with a pumped horde. Hordewing Skaab gives everyone flying, and Army of the Damned or Diregraf Horde floods the board for a final attack.
keys: Another zombie dies (non-decayed) → a 2/2 decayed zombie. End step: sacrifice a zombie to draw.
Lord with deathtouch; each zombie that dies drains an opponent for 1.
Draws a card whenever a zombie dies.
All your zombies fly, and combat damage lets you loot.
tips: Decayed tokens can't block and are sacrificed after they attack. Feed them to Wilhelt's end step trigger or Carrion Feeder.
Wilhelt only replaces zombies that didn't have decayed, so sacrifice real zombies to Viscera Seer when you want a token back.
Gravecrawler can be recast from your graveyard while you control a zombie.
Noxious Ghoul gives all non-zombie creatures -1/-1 whenever a zombie enters: a slow-motion board wipe for your opponents.
mulligan: Keep 3 lands with both colors and two cheap zombies or a rock. A turn-2 Undead Augur or Cryptbreaker is a strong start.
